title: Ogie Diaz surprises his daughter with P1M on her 25th birthday
summary: Talent manager Ogie Diaz gave his daughter Erin P1 million for remaining single and childless at 25. Erin uploaded the video on her YouTube channel, where she documented her simple birthday…

blocks.text: Talent manager Ogie Diaz gave his daughter Erin P1 million for remaining single and childless at 25. Erin uploaded the video on her YouTube channel, where she documented her simple birthday celebration. She was more than surprised as her father, Ogie, handed her a check for P1 million. According to Ogie, he kept his promise to his children by giving them ₱1 million each if they stayed single and childless at 25. "Pangako ko sa kanila... pag 25 wala pa kayong asawa, wala pa kayong anak. Gusto ko kasi i-enjoy nila kabataan.” Not expecting anything on her birthday, Erin got emotional as she found out about her father's surprise. Meanwhile, Ogie clarified that giving his children the money was not meant to flaunt wealth, but to give them the freedom they deserve before settling down. "Baka sabihin nagyayabang, 25 na kasi siya (Erin) sabi ko kasi walang asawa, walang anak at 25 (may isang milyon) kasi gusto ko i-enjoy nila ‘yung kanilang kabataan kasi mahirap mag-asawa o nakipag-live in na tapos magkakaanak tapos iiwan mo ‘yung anak mo sa amin tapos gigimik-gimik ka kaya i-enjoy mo muna (pagiging single),” Ogie said.
